name: Sanki Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Sanki Engineering Co., Ltd. provides various social infrastructure services in Japan. It provides facilities construction services in the areas of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), as well as plumbing services for buildings, which cover HVAC systems, water supply and drainage plumbing systems, disaster prevention systems, kitchen systems, district heating and cooling plants, and nuclear power related facilities.
